jd_template:
{company} has an opening for a {role} based in {location}.

The work:
- handle a varied workload with changing priorities
- keep careful records
- work with people from outside the organisation

You will have:
- experience coping with a sudden change in priorities
- experience finding and fixing a mistake before it caused harm
- experience building a good working relationship with someone outside your organisation

stories.title: Caught a billing error before it went out
stories.body:
**Situation.** A batch of invoices was ready to send at the end of the month.

**Task.** I was doing the final check before they went out.

**Action.** I noticed that one customer's total was ten times the usual amount, traced it to a figure entered with an extra zero, and held the batch while it was corrected.

**Result.** The invoices went out a day later with the right amounts, and a second check on large totals was added to the process.

stories.title: Rescheduled a week of work after a sudden change
stories.body:
**Situation.** On a Monday morning an urgent request arrived that needed most of my week.

**Task.** I had to fit it in without dropping the work already promised.

**Action.** I listed everything due that week, asked each person waiting which of their items could move, and agreed new dates for three of them before starting the urgent request.

**Result.** The urgent request was finished on Thursday, and every moved item was delivered by its new date.

directives: Prepare for two requirements: the one your note "Caught a billing error before it went out" covers, and the one your story that is not in your notes fits.

untold_stories.title: Kept a running log of every query and its answer
untold_stories.body:
**Situation.** Questions about wording came in from several people, and answers were getting lost in long email threads.

**Task.** I wanted one place where every question and its answer could be found again.

**Action.** I kept a shared log with the date, the question, who asked it and the answer agreed, and I added each new one the same day.

**Result.** Repeat questions dropped, and a new colleague used the log to learn the agreed wording in their first week.
